title: Shipping overview
text: Shipping reads one authorized overview across projects, unions each project’s bounded live/recent run window before presentation, and shows each shared release once. Another project’s busy window cannot truncate a selected project’s releases. Project chips filter by member project, or the owning project of an itemless run. Cards show available release facts while auxiliary QA evidence and flow names load; loading and failed evidence reads stay explicit. Member QA retains the release gate’s acceptance authority, and landing attribution keeps the first successful delivery in each environment. Deployed timing remains subject to production proof.
